title: Reservation (canonical entity)
description: Canonical Reservation emitted by every connector. Money is an exact decimal string with 2 fraction digits (never float). Dates are property-local business dates YYYY-MM-DD (never UTC instants). Status is the closed canonical vocabulary; unknown vendor values Block, never guessed.

reservation_id.description: Canonical key shared by the connector, runtime and verifier.

property_id.description: Owning property; selects the property-local business-date calendar.

guest_name.description: Nullable demo field; vendors may omit or null it.

departure_date.description: Property-local business date of departure; on or after arrival_date.

status.description: Closed canonical vocabulary (plan §2.4 enum_map with on_unknown: block).

total_amount.description: Exact decimal string with 2 fraction digits; Decimal end to end, never float.

updated_at.description: Source timestamp of last change; an aware UTC instant, never a naive business date.
